# Inbound Lead

`sales.sit.inbound_lead` · v1.0.0 · **draft**

Owned by `sales.qualification.lead_qualification`


> Someone came to us. They raised their hand — requested a demo, replied to a campaign, or arrived through an introduction. The defining property is that intent already exists and our job is to qualify it quickly rather than manufacture it. Speed dominates: inbound intent decays faster than any other kind, and the load-set below is deliberately small so the first response is not waiting on a full committee map.
